<b>Swift Step</b> is an [[Abilities (Silksong)|Ability]] that [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] acquires in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It allows her to dash and sprint, helping her traverse [[Areas (Silksong)|areas]] quickly and jump across longer gaps.

== Function ==
* Tap SPRINT to dash forwards. This can be used on the ground or while airborne.
** While airborne, hold DOWN and tap SPRINT to dash downwards. If SPRINT is held, Hornet does not stop the down-dash until the button is released.
* Hold SPRINT to run along the ground. Hornet moves 112% faster and can jump farther.
* While sprinting or dashing, press ATTACK to perform a run-slash with the [[Needle]]. The specific move varies depending on the equipped [[Crest]]. 
** Performing a run-slash resets the needle's attack cooldown, allowing Hornet to perform a non-run-slash attack again immediately. All crests except the Reaper and Shaman crest don't interrupt the dash when performing a run-slash, and as such require Hornet to stop holding SPRINT or hit an enemy in order to not run-slash again.
** The Wanderer Crest has a special followup attack when ATTACK is pressed after hitting an enemy with a run-slash. Both of these hits count as part of the run-slash, which means performing the second hit will reset the needle's attack cooldown.
* While swimming, tap or hold SPRINT to swim faster. Doing so does not allow for attacks or longer jumps like it does on land.
* With the [[Silkspeed Anklets]] equipped, sprinting is 34% faster but drains 1 [[Silk]] strand every 6 seconds.
Swift Step is necessary to complete some jumps throughout the game. For larger gaps, Hornet can sprint, make a longer jump, and then dash in midair to clear them.

===Run-slashes===
*[[Hunter Crest]]: Hornet strikes with the point of her needle and keeps running on a miss. On a hit, Hornet is launched into the air, similarly to a down-slash.
*[[Reaper Crest]]: Hornet performs an uppercut, raising her into the air and stopping her run with a jumping backflip.
*[[Wanderer Crest]]: Hornet performs a quick, short-range slash, which does not stop movement on a miss. On hit, Hornet darts up and back. Another attack input shortly after a hit results in a followup attack where Hornet dashes back in, launching her into the air on hit. Both hits can generate Silk.
*[[Beast Crest]]: Hornet hops up and slashes her Needle in a wider arc. On a successful hit, she leaps up while keeping some forward momentum.
*[[Witch Crest]]: Hornet sweeps her needle twice, carrying her forward. If she hits something, she briefly vanishes after the second hit before leaping upwards. Roughly 2x Needle damage is dealt across 3 hits. The first and second hits can both generate Silk, for a total of 2 Silk. Unlike other run-slashes, this Crest's run-slash does not have a startup animation, making gauging the initial dash of Swift Step crucial to avoid contact damage.
*[[Architect Crest]]: Hornet dashes and drills forwards. Holding the attack button makes Hornet pause briefly to charge, extending the spin time, dash distance, and the number of hits it deals. With a full charge, it deals double damage and strikes twice as many times. The damage is spread roughly evenly across hits. On hit, Hornet is launched into the air.
*[[Shaman Crest]]: Hornet hops forwards and shoots a circular energy wave that pushes her back. This always pushes Hornet back the same amount, but has a small blind spot directly in front of her, meaning it can miss smaller enemies at close range.

== How to Acquire ==
Swift Step can be found in a [[Weaver Burial Spire]] in the northernmost area of [[Deep Docks]].
